from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class OperatingCashFlowEntry(BaseModel):
    """Operating cash flow value extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name, as named in the filing")
    cash_flow_value: float | None = Field(description="The operating cash flow amount; losses are negative")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions', etc.")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this figure")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt with the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    operating_cash_flow_entries: list[OperatingCashFlowEntry]
